translations.idiomatic: Yan Zuan continued:

sentences.zh: 今迎太子神柩，孤魂獨行，太孫幼沖，不可涉道。

translations.literal: Now welcoming crown prince spirit-casket—solitary shade sole travels—imperial great-grandson tender-dash—cannot ford roads.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince's catafalque is coming home unattended, while the imperial great-grandson is too young for the bitter road east.

sentences.zh: 謂可遣妃奉迎遠路，令其父衍隨行衛護。

translations.literal: Say can dispatch Consort undertake welcome far road—order her father Yang Yan accompany travel guard-protect.
translations.idiomatic: Send his consort to meet the cortège on the distant road and set her father Yang Yan at her side as escort.

sentences.zh: 皇太子初見誣陷，臣家門無祐，三世假親，具嘗辛苦，以家觀國，固知太子有變。

translations.literal: When imperial heir first sight slandered-framed—Your servant household-gate lacked blessing—three generations sham-kin—all tasted bitterness—take house observe state—firmly knew crown prince had change-disaster.
translations.idiomatic: When they first framed the heir, my house—three generations joined to the throne by paper marriages—had no luck and knew every grief; what our kin suffered told me the palace would turn on him.

sentences.zh: 臣故求副監國，欲依邴吉故事，距違來使，供養擁護，身親飲食醫藥，冀足救危。

translations.literal: Your servant therefore sought vice Supervisor-of-State—wished rely on Bing Ji's old precedent—ward off resist coming envoys—supply-nurture embrace-guard—body personally drink-food medicine—hope sufficient rescue peril.
translations.idiomatic: So I begged to serve as vice overseer of the realm, to replay Bing Ji's old trick of barring false couriers, to feed and shield the boy with my own hands and physic—anything to snatch him from ruin.

sentences.zh: 主者以臣名資輕淺，不肯見與。

translations.literal: Responsible officials because Your servant name standing light shallow—unwilling grant see give.
translations.idiomatic: The bureaus refused: my name was too slight for such trust.

sentences.zh: 世人見笑，謂為此職進退難居，有必死憂。

translations.literal: Age's people seeing laugh—say for this post advance-retreat hard dwell—have certain-death worry.
translations.idiomatic: The world sneered that the post was a trap—advance or retreat, you died.

sentences.zh: 臣獨以為苟全儲君，賈氏所誅，甘心所願。

translations.literal: Your servant alone deemed if preserve heir-apparent—even Jia clan execute—sweet-heart wished desire.
translations.idiomatic: I alone reckoned that saving the storied heir—even at the price of every Jia head—would be joy enough.

sentences.zh: 今監國御史直副皆當三族，侍衛無狀，實自宜然。

translations.literal: Now regency supervising censors and their direct aides all slated Three-Clans extinction—retinue guards remiss—in truth rightly thus.
translations.idiomatic: Now the inspectors and aides who guarded the regency heir stand sentenced to three-generation extinction—the household guard rightly shares the scaffold on paper.

sentences.zh: 臣謂其小人，不足具責。

translations.literal: Your servant deem them petty men—not worth fully blame.
translations.idiomatic: Yet they were frightened little men—not worth exhausting your wrath upon.

sentences.zh: 故孔子曰：「可以托六尺之孤，臨大節而不可奪。

translations.literal: Therefore Confucius said: 'He may be entrusted with a six-foot orphan; confronted with great crisis he cannot be wrested.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the Master's words: Charge him with a boy in mourning; drive him toward the breaking wave—and he cannot be peeled from integrity.

sentences.zh: 」是以聖王慎選。

translations.literal: ' Thereby sagely kings careful-select.
translations.idiomatic: That is why sage-kings sift appointments as if their lives hung on them.

sentences.zh: 故河南尹向雄，昔能犯難葬故將鐘會，文帝嘉之，始拔顯用，至於先帝，以為右率。

translations.literal: Therefore Henan Intendant Xiang Xiong—anciently able violate-difficulty bury former general Zhong Hui—Wendi praised him—first pulled manifest employ—reaching former emperor—made him Right Lead.
translations.idiomatic: Consider Xiang Xiong of Henan, who braved edict to bury his old commander Zhong Hui; Emperor Wen exalted him, pulled him from obscurity, and the late emperor named him right-side guide to the heir.

sentences.zh: 如間之事，若得向雄之比，則豈可觸哉！

translations.literal: If touching recent affairs—if obtain Xiong's likeness—then how could be harmed!
translations.idiomatic: Had the latest summons found a conscience like Xiang Xiong's clasped to the boy, what hand could harm him?

sentences.zh: 此二使者，但為愚怯，亦非與謀，但可誅身，自全三族。

translations.literal: These two envoys—only were foolish cowardly—also not join plot—only can execute body—self preserve Three Clans.
translations.idiomatic: The two couriers were craven dolts, not plotters—behead them if you must, but spare their kin.

sentences.zh: 如郭俶、郭斌，則于刑為當。

translations.literal: As for Guo Xu, Guo Bin—then as to punishment as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xu and Guo Bin are another matter—here the blade fits.

sentences.zh: 又東宮亦宜妙選忠直亮正，如向雄比。

translations.literal: Further Eastern Palace also ought wonder-select loyal straight bright upright—such as Xiong's comparison.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Palace itself needs men as straight as Xiang Xiong.

sentences.zh: 陛下千秋萬歲之後，太孫幼沖，選置兵衛，宜得柱石之士如周昌者。

translations.literal: When Your Majesty thousand autumns myriad years after—imperial great-grandson tender-dash—select station arms guard—ought obtain pillar-stone knights—such as Zhou Chang's sort.
translations.idiomatic: After Your Majesty mounts the crane, when the great-grandson is still milk-teeth small, ring him with Zhou Chang granite—soldiers sworn to blunt any blade turned inward.

sentences.zh: 世俗淺薄，士無廉節，賈謐小兒，恃寵恣睢，而淺中弱植之徒，更相翕習，故世號魯公二十四友。

translations.literal: Common custom shallow thin—knights lacking integrity modesty—Jia Mi little boy—relying favour reckless pride—yet shallow-middle weak-root followers—mutually inhale-learn—therefore generation titles Duke of Lu twenty-four Friends.
translations.idiomatic: The age is vulgar, its men brittle; young Jia Mi struts on favor while shallow-root hangers-on imitate him—the world mocks them as Duke of Lu's twenty-four sworn companions.

sentences.zh: 又謐前見臣表理太子，曰：「閻兒作此為健，然觀其意，欲與諸司馬家同。

translations.literal: Further Mi formerly seeing Your servant memorial straighten heir-apparent—said: 'The Yan lad did boldly here—yet inspecting his intention—wishes with various Sima houses same.
translations.idiomatic: When I petitioned for the heir, Mi once sneered—'Brave work for Yan's cub—but study his motive: he means to clasp hands with every Sima branch alive.'

sentences.zh: 」皆為臣寒心。

translations.literal: ' All chilled Your servant's heart.
translations.idiomatic: —and my blood ran cold hearing it.

sentences.zh: 伏見詔書，稱明滿奮、樂廣。

translations.literal: Prostrate seeing edict pronounce brightness Man Fen, Yue Guang.
translations.idiomatic: I applaud the edict that singles out Man Fen and Yue Guang for clarity.

sentences.zh: 侍郎賈胤，與謐親理，而亦疏遠，往免父喪之後，停家五年，雖為小屈，有識貴之。

translations.literal: Attendant Gentleman Jia Yin—with Mi intimately related-by-marriage and managed—yet also kept estranged-distance—past after completing father's mourning—stopped home five years—although termed small setback—those with discernment esteemed him.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Gentleman Jia Yin was tethered to Mi by marriage brokerage yet edged away; five years mourning at home looked like setback and men of judgment prized him for it.

sentences.zh: 潘岳、繆征等皆謐父党，共相沈浮，人士羞之，聞其晏然，莫不為怪。

translations.literal: Pan Yue, Miao Zheng et al. all Mi father's faction—mutually sink-float—literati-of-office shamed them—hearing his peace—none not deemed strange.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Yue, Miao Zheng, and the rest floated in Jia Chong's faction; gentlemen held their nose at them yet marveled how lightly they ride the purge.

sentences.zh: 今詔書暴揚其罪，並皆遣出，百姓咸雲清當，臣獨謂非。

translations.literal: Now edict book sudden-display their crimes—together all expelled sent out—commoners all say pure proper—Your servant alone call not.
translations.idiomatic: The court now parades their guilt and casts them wholesale; the lanes cheer—yet Your servant disagrees.

sentences.zh: 但嶽征二十四人，宜皆齊黜，以肅風教。

translations.literal: Only Pan Yue, Miao Zheng twenty-four persons—ought all uniformly dismissed—to stern wind-teaching.
translations.idiomatic: Dismiss Pan Yue, Miao Zheng, and the entire score of twenty-four together—only that scours the lesson home.

sentences.zh: 朝廷善其忠烈，擢為漢中太守。

translations.literal: Court praised his loyalty fierce—promoted Hanzhong Governor.
translations.idiomatic: The court praised his fearless loyalty and raised him governor of Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 趙王倫死，既葬，纘以車轢其塚。

translations.literal: Prince Zhao Lun died—already buried—Zuan thereby cart crushed his mound.
translations.idiomatic: After Prince Zhao Sima Lun was buried, Zuan drove a wagon across his mound.

sentences.zh: 時張華兄子景後徙漢中，纘又表宜還。

translations.literal: At time Zhang Hua elder brother's son Jing afterward transferred Hanzhong—Zuan again memorial deemed ought return.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when Zhang Hua's nephew Jing was shifted to Hanzhong, Zuan argued he belonged back at court.

sentences.zh: 纘不護細行，而慷慨好大節。

translations.literal: Zuan did not guard fine conduct—yet open-giving admired great cardinal-integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Zuan shrugged at petty reputability but prized the grand virtues.

sentences.zh: 卒于官，時年五十九。

translations.literal: Died at post—timing age fifty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office at fifty-nine.

sentences.zh: 纘五子，皆開朗有才力。

translations.literal: Zuan five sons—all open bright had talent-force.
translations.idiomatic: His five sons were open-hearted men of parts.

sentences.zh: 長子亨為遼西太守，屬王濬自用其人，亨不得之官。

translations.literal: Eldest son Heng Liaoxi Governor—because Wang Jun self-employed his people—Heng unable attain office-assignment.
translations.idiomatic: Eldest son Yan Heng was named to Liaoxi, yet Wang Jun planted his own men and barred Heng from ever taking command.

sentences.zh: 依青州刺史苟晞，刑政苛虐，亨數切諫，為晞所害。

translations.literal: Relied Qingzhou Inspector Gou Xi—punishments governance harsh brutal—Heng repeatedly incisive remonstrated—by Xi harmed killed.
translations.idiomatic: He took refuge with Qingzhou inspector Gou Xi, whose rule was savage; Heng rebuked him again and again until Gou murdered him.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：湣懷之廢也，天下稱其冤。

translations.literal: Historian-courtiers say: Minhuai's deposition—Under Heaven titled his wrong.
translations.idiomatic: The historians write: when Minhuai fell, the realm called it murder by edict.

sentences.zh: 然皆懼亂政之參夷，懾淫嬖之凶忍，遂使謀臣懷忠而結舌，義士蓄憤而吞聲。

translations.literal: Yet all feared chaos-government's three-clan extirpation—cowed wanton-favorite's fierce cruel—thereupon caused planning ministers cherish loyalty yet tie tongue—righteous knights store fury yet swallow voice.
translations.idiomatic: Yet terror of junta butchery and the favorite's knives sealed every planner's mouth and turned every honest man's shout inward.

sentences.zh: 閻續伯官既微于侍郎，位不登於執戟，輕生重義，視死如歸，伏奏而待嚴誅，輿棺以趨鼎鑊，察言觀行，豈非忠直壯乎！

translations.literal: Yan Xubo's office already slight compared Gentleman-in-Attendance—rank not ascend compared halberdier—light life weight righteousness—view death like return—prostrate memorial awaiting stern execution—cart coffin toward cauldron-cleaver—inspect speech observe action—surely not loyalty straight grandeur!
translations.idiomatic: Yan Zuan, style Xubo, sat lower than a palace gentleman and never rose to halberdier rank—yet he weighed righteousness above breath, rolled his coffin toward the cooking cauldron, and lay prone awaiting the blade: read his words, watch his deeds—was that not stalwart loyalty?

sentences.zh: 顧視晉朝公卿，曾不得與其徒隸齒也。

translations.literal: Turning-glance Jin court dukes ministers—not once obtained compare their thrall-stable teeth-ranked.
translations.idiomatic: Beside him the gilt ministers of Jin hardly rated beside his carriage lackeys.

sentences.zh: 茂伯篤終，哭王經以全節。

translations.literal: Maobo pure-to-end—wept Wang Jing thereby complete integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Maobo finished as he lived—mourning Wang Jing to seal his honor.

sentences.zh: 休然追遠，理鄧艾以成名。

translations.literal: Xiuran chasing far-off justice—straightened Deng Ai thereby complete fame.
translations.idiomatic: Xiuran prosecuted a dead man's case until Deng Ai was posthumously cleared—that was how he earned fame.

sentences.zh: 故得義感明時，仁流枯骨。

translations.literal: Therefore obtained righteousness stirred bright age—grace flowed withered bones.
translations.idiomatic: Their justice lit the dynasty and spilled mercy even on mouldering bones.

sentences.zh: 雖硃勃追論新息，欒布奏事彭王，弗之尚也。

translations.literal: Although Zhu Bo pursued discuss Xinxi-Hou—Luan Bu memorialized affair King Peng—not reach surpass those.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Bo's plea for the Marquis of Xinxi after Ma Yuan's fall and Luan Bu's memorial pleading for King Peng of Liang before Gaozu still do not surpass them.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：感義收會，篤終理艾。

translations.literal: Eulogy says: touched righteousness collecting Hui—pure-end straightening Ai.
translations.idiomatic: The verdict sings: Moved by principle, Xiang assembled Zhong Hui's bones; steadfast to the grave, Duan vindicated Deng Ai.

sentences.zh: 道既相侔，名亦俱泰。

translations.literal: Way already mutually equal—name also together great.
translations.idiomatic: Their paths marched in step—their reputations loom together.

sentences.zh: 續伯區區，輿櫬陳謩。

translations.literal: Xubo petty—bier-casket lodged counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Lowly Xubo shouldered his bier yet schooled the throne.

sentences.zh: 偪茲淫嬖，弗遂良圖。

translations.literal: Pressed by these corrupting favorites—did not fulfil good scheme.
translations.idiomatic: Vicious favorites boxed him round—sound counsel never ripened.

sentences.zh: 啜其泣矣，何嗟及乎！

translations.literal: Sip their weeping—what sigh reach!
translations.idiomatic: He ends like the ode—'they sip their tears; why sigh when it is too late?'
